title: Immaculate Constellation USAP set up in 2017 to sequester overhead UAP data

tellings.quote: So, a program like Immaculate Constellation or a legacy program satellite because Immaculate Constellation isn't a legacy program. It was a it was a reactionary US app established in 2017 would clip out data that would probably depict anomalies like a UFO and sequester it into MCOM or another legacy program site.

plain: A highly secret Pentagon program called Immaculate Constellation was set up in 2017 as a reaction to events that year, and its job is to cut out satellite and other overhead data that may show UFOs and lock it away in older secret programs, one of which he calls MCOM. This comes from an online researcher who goes by UAPGerb, who explains it without naming a source. If true, it would mean the government is actively hiding its best images of unexplained objects.
